parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the ECS instances. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).

- The instances must be in the same VPC as the target cluster.

- An instance can belong to only one cluster at a time.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The logon password to set for the instances.

parameters.name: TargetClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the target cluster.
